text:
Alex Kim: Heads up — I'm starting a small migration PR to update our Dedicated autoscale policy examples from policy_v1 -> policy_v2 in the provisioning guide. Need a quick review on semantics.
Maria Lopez: Nice — can you call out the breaking fields? IIRC cooldown_seconds changed to cooldown.s and we added an emergency_fallback block.
Alex Kim: Yep. Short summary in the PR body + sample YAML diff. Example I added:

```yaml
autoscale:
  version: "policy_v2"
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 12
  metrics:
    - type: rps
      target: 1200
  cooldown:
    scale_up: 30
    scale_down: 90
  emergency_fallback:
    mode: "overflow-queue"
    max_queue_secs: 60
```

Samir Patel: That looks good. One nit: the handbook link in the docs currently points to /docs/dedicated/autoscale which is the old anchor. We should update it to /handbook/provisioning/autoscale#policy-v2. I'll paste the PR url when I open it.
Kevin Chu: Also add an SDK example (python) showing how to create the policy via the CLI client — many folks copy-paste from docs.
Alex Kim: Good call. Draft SDK snippet below, please verify types:

```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient

client = DedicatedClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
policy = {
    "version": "policy_v2",
    "min_replicas": 2,
    "max_replicas": 12,
    "metrics": [{"type": "rps", "target": 1200}],
    "cooldown": {"scale_up": 30, "scale_down": 90}
}
client.create_autoscale_policy(tenant_id="acme", policy=policy)
```

Lee Carter: Quick doc wording suggestion: avoid the word "fallback" alone since we have an "emergency_fallback" concept. Maybe say "emergency degradation" section. Small wording change.
Maria Lopez: Agree. Also can we add a short checklist in the migration guide: (1) update YAML fields, (2) run config linter (link), (3) run local autoscale simulation (link).
Alex Kim: I'll add a 3-step checklist and link to the linter and sim. @docs-bot can you run link-check on the branch after I push?
docs-bot: link-check queued for branch alex/autoscale-policy-v2 — results expected in ~5m :mag:
Samir Patel: One more: update the SLA table note where we explain preemption behavior under high load — policy_v2's emergency_fallback will queue vs. preempt reserved pools. Add a footnote.
Kevin Chu: I'll add the footnote and a short code comment in the SDK snippet showing expected exception types when create_autoscale_policy fails (QuotaExceededError). :+1:
Alex Kim: Thanks everyone — I'll push changes in the next 20m and request reviews. If link-check passes, I'll merge and backport a tiny note to the quickstart. :shipit:
Maria Lopez: :eyes: ping if you want me to do copyedits after merge.
